title: Hold mutations until a matching human approval exists
narrative: Fangore’s product allows an agent to propose a privileged write, but the write must not run until a human approval matches the action digest. Without that token, policy returns ask-human — not allow. ASK_HUMAN path for Dots MH-DOTS-04[^insp-dots-04-pending] and approval interrupt for MH-DOTS-02[^insp-dots-02-review].
implementation:
`JudgementPolicy.require_approval_for` plus `JudgementFacts.approvals` / `action_digest` in `decide()`: missing approval yields `ASK_HUMAN` with `MISSING_APPROVAL`. Approvals bind to executed args via digest keys.

Covers: POL-04, GAT-04.
validation: Kind `human_review_pending` → `_run_human_review_pending`. Soft expects: ASK_HUMAN without token; ALLOW when digest approval present. Unit coverage in `tests/test_judgement_policy.py`.
